cultural-patterns-forces.alt: Diagram: on the left, arrows point in toward a group, labeled centripetal force, which pulls people together, with examples a shared language, a national holiday and a shared religion. On the right, arrows point out from a group, labeled centrifugal force, which pushes people apart, with examples two languages in separate regions and religious differences. A note says the same trait can unite one region and divide the whole country.
